data.name: MarketplaceNotAvailable
data.value: Installing modules from packages is not available in this build of the panel.

data.name: ModuleNotPackageable
data.value: The package declares a module that ships with the panel itself, so it cannot be installed from a package.

data.name: ModuleIdTaken
data.value: A module with this id is already part of the panel.

data.name: ModuleAssemblyReserved
data.value: The package carries an assembly the panel reserves for itself.

data.name: ModuleAssemblyUnreadable
data.value: The module's assembly could not be read.

data.name: ModuleAgentCapabilityUndeclared
data.value: The module uses a part of the agent that its manifest does not declare.

data.name: ModuleManifestUnreadable
data.value: The module's manifest could not be read.

data.name: ModuleManifestInvalid
data.value: The module's manifest breaks the module contract.

data.name: ModulePackageNotAsAnnounced
data.value: The package does not match what the catalogue announced for it.

data.name: MigrationSectionInvalid
data.value: This part of the package cannot be read, so it cannot be imported.

data.name: MigrationTargetAccountMissing
data.value: The account to import into does not exist yet. The import stopped.

data.name: MigrationNameTaken
data.value: This name is already used on this server. Account names are kept as they are and are not renamed.

data.name: MigrationDomainTaken
data.value: This domain is already hosted on this server.

data.name: MigrationPlanLimitExceeded
data.value: The package holds more than the chosen plan allows.

data.name: MigrationPlanMissing
data.value: The chosen plan does not exist on this server.

data.name: MigrationPhpVersionMissing
data.value: This site needs a PHP version that is not installed on this server. Install it first.

data.name: MigrationCronImportedDisabled
data.value: Cron entries are imported switched off. Enable them after the move, when this server is live.

data.name: MigrationCertificateReissue
data.value: Issue this certificate again once the name points at this server. It is not carried over.

data.name: MigrationCertificateUpload
data.value: Upload this certificate again. Its key never leaves the old server, so it is not carried over.

data.name: MigrationBackupIdTaken
data.value: A backup with the same identifier already exists on this server.

data.name: MigrationRollbackRefused
data.value: The account was not created by this import, so it was not deleted.
